title: Prep for New Year: Personalized Product Ideas
summary: Get ready for the festive season! Read this guide and get ideas for personalized Christmas presents that you can offer in your online shop.
body_markdown:
As the holiday season and New Year approach, Christmas presents the perfect opportunity for personalized gifts. The festive atmosphere encourages thoughtfulness, making it an ideal moment to offer custom products in your online store. It's not just a feeling either: 72% of US adults plan to buy gifts this season, and over half say a meaningful or personal gift is their main goal, which is exactly what personalization delivers.


Personalized gifts carry special meaning, reflecting the spirit of giving and thoughtfulness during the season. Offering customizable products allows your customers to create unique, heartfelt gifts that celebrate personal connections.


By adding a personal touch to your offerings, you cater to the demand for meaningful presents that capture the joy of Christmas.


## **Top 8 Best Personalized Gifts for Christmas to Sell**


#### **Custom ornaments**


Christmas[ornaments](https://www.customily.com/sell-personalized-products/ornaments) are a classic, cherished gift that can be passed from generation to generation. Offering personalized ornaments with family names, special dates, or custom messages allows your customers to create unique decorations for their trees. Offer a variety of materials, such as wood, glass, or ceramic, and customization options like engraving or full-color printing. These ornaments not only add a personal touch to Christmas décor but also make for memorable keepsakes.


#### **Personalized Christmas stockings**


Custom stockings are a festive and fun way to celebrate the holidays. You can offer stockings personalized with family members' names, favorite colors, or themed designs like reindeer, snowflakes, or Santa Claus. These stockings add a personal touch to Christmas traditions and are perfect for families looking to create a cozy, personalized holiday display.


#### **Custom family portraits**


Personalized family portraits, either hand-drawn or digitally illustrated, make a thoughtful and sentimental Christmas gift. Customers can provide photos of their families, pets, or even special memories, and you can offer unique, artistic renditions that capture their loved ones. These portraits can be framed, printed on canvas, or even included on holiday cards, making them a versatile and treasured gift option.


#### **Personalized Christmas apparel**


Matching Christmas[apparel](https://www.customily.com/sell-personalized-products/t-shirts) like pajamas or sweaters is a popular holiday tradition for families. Offering personalized clothes with family names, fun holiday patterns, or festive sayings like "Merry and Bright" or "Santa's Helpers" makes this gift even more special. From cozy flannel sets to soft cotton loungewear, custom apparel is perfect for Christmas morning photos and snuggling by the fire.


#### **Personalized wrapping paper**


For those who love attention to detail, custom wrapping paper, printed with family names, festive patterns, or personal photos, elevates the gift-giving experience and makes presents stand out under the tree. It's a small touch that adds a lot of personality and joy to Christmas presents.


#### **Personalized Christmas cards**


Christmas cards are a timeless tradition, and offering customizable options allows people to send truly unique holiday greetings. You can provide templates where customers can add family photos, messages, or even illustrations that reflect their holiday spirit. Personalized Christmas cards are a meaningful way to connect with loved ones, making them a popular and heartwarming gift choice.


#### **Customizable Christmas gift boxes**


A curated gift box filled with personalized items like candles, chocolates, ornaments, or cozy socks is a perfect gift for friends, family, or colleagues. Allowing customers to customize the items or the design of the boxes creates a thoughtful gift that suits the recipient’s tastes.


#### **Custom holiday mugs**


Warm beverages are a big part of the Christmas season, making personalized mugs a practical as well as heartfelt gift. You can offer mugs customized with names, holiday-themed graphics, or festive quotes like "Warm Wishes" or "Let It Snow." These mugs can be paired with hot cocoa kits or specialty teas, creating a cozy and thoughtful Christmas gift that customers will use throughout the holiday season.


#### **Personalized advent calendars**


Advent calendars have moved well beyond chocolate, and a personalized one makes the countdown to Christmas feel special every single day. Offer calendars with a family name, a child's name on each door, or a custom photo background. Customily's[Calendar Design Tool](https://www.customily.com/post/january-updates-new-personalization-features-in-customily) makes it easy to let shoppers adjust fonts, colors, and markers so every calendar feels one of a kind.


#### **Personalized pet holiday gifts**


Pets are part of the family, and shoppers love including them in the gifting. Custom pet stockings with the pet's name, engraved holiday collar tags, or a pet-themed ornament with their photo are all quick, high-margin additions to a holiday collection that pet owners rarely skip.
